I also did not find strong direct evidence that 2024 was mainly classic patronage spending; the clearer pattern is a mix of IMF/WB-backed adjustment, targeted social transfers, and coercive containment of economic dissent.","evidence":[{"title":"World Bank Group Statement of Support to Egypt’s Development and Reform Efforts","publisher":"World Bank Group","date":"2024-03-18","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/statement/2024/03/18/world-bank-group-statement-of-support-to-egypt-s-development-and-reform-efforts","summary":"The Bank says Egypt’s partnership is aimed at inclusive growth, private-sector job creation, human capital, resilience, and protection of the poorest and most vulnerable.
